main_text.head: PROBLEMATVM.
main_text.l: 27 An concubitus Diabolorum cum hominibus sit verus,
an imaginarius ? 444
28 An angeli vere possint substantiam unam transmutare
in aliam ? 446
29 An angeli quandoque assumant corpora, quibus appareant, & qualia illa sint[?] ? ibid.
30 An angeli per se localiter moueantur, & quomodo ? 448
31 An Diabolus quandoque vere corpora hominum[?] obsideat, & quomodo ? 449
32 An Diabolus ex corporibus obsessis possit expelli, & quo-
modo ? 450
33 An Diabolus possit praestigiis suis fallere & deludere sen-
sus hominis tam exteriores, quam interiores ? 452
34 An Diabolus possit ventos, pluuias, grandines, & tem-
pestates excitare & quomodo ? 453
35 An Diabolus possit vera miracula edere ? 454
36 An Diaboli sint autores spectrorum & tumultuum no-
cturnorum[?] homines terrificantium ? ibid.
1 An detur forma substantialis? ibid.
2 Utrum forma substantialis sit substantia incorporea, an corporea? 457.
3 An ulla forma substantialis generetur? 458
4 An forma substantialis alia sit simplex, alia composita? 459
5 An forma substantialis recte distribuatur in naturam & animam? ibid.
6 An ulla anima sit substantia corporea? 460
7 An anima sit ex traduce? ibid.
8 An anima sufficienter distribuatur in vegetantem, sentientem & rationalem? 461
9 An inter animas sola anima rationalis sit immortalis? ibid.
10 An anima rationalis habeat facultates & operationes realiter distinctas à facultatibus & operationibus hominis? 462
main_text.head: De corporibus, Cap. VI. 463
main_text.l: 1 An omne corpus per se sit quantum? ibid.

page.notes: Part 1 of 2: the lower part of the page is cut off and is not transcribed here. Doubtful readings: "sint" in entry 29 and "hominum" in entry 31 are partly obscured; "nocturnorum" in entry 36 is hard to read at the line break. The page number is not printed on this part; the handwritten "590" at the right margin is not transcribed.
